services.name: Hugs for Horses
services.desc: Hugs for Horses, Therapeutic Riding Program founded in 1988, provides children and adults with physical, intellectual, and behavioral disabilities the healing power of horses to change their outcomes in life. Rona Jacobs, owner of the Equestrian Center and renowned professional horse trainer and riding instructor, realized long ago that horseback riding provides a package of physical, psychological, and social benefits that are especially effective and valuable for people who are differently abled.
